cmd:hooks.note: :hooks opens the hooks list (ListClaudeHooks); add and delete save with PutClaudeHooks; Remove all is DeleteClaudeHooks. Same daemon RPCs as the TUI, so both read one hooks block

overlay-ref:hook-form.note: Add and edit-in-place hook form (event, matcher, command, timeout) over PutClaudeHooks: a desktop form with Enter/Esc in place of the TUI's five-key edit overlay; changing the event or matcher moves the hook, like the TUI's HookEdit

overlay-ref:hook-save-conflict.note: A stale save (claude_hooks_conflict) asks to overwrite; overwrite re-reads the revision and puts the same block again. Cancel keeps the file; reopening :hooks reloads

overlay-ref:provider-form.note: Custom provider form (name, base URL, default model) over PutCustomProvider, list, delete (DeleteCustomProvider) and role routes (SetCustomProviderRoute, current route read with ListCustomProviderRoutes) from the View menu or palette; the same daemon store the TUI uses, so both frontends list the same providers

overlay-ref:provider-key-form.note: The API key is a password field in the provider form: blank keeps the stored key, typing sets it, a checkbox removes it. Only the key state and fingerprint are ever shown; the key goes to the daemon vault and is never read back

overlay-ref:message-bridge-form.note: Signal and iMessage bridge form (enabled, account, allow-from, working dir) over PutMessageBridge, with remove (DeleteMessageBridge), from the View menu or palette
